title: Andaman Islands vs Maldives: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: For most travelers seeking value, adventure, and local interaction, the Andaman Islands are a superior choice, offering a richer experience at a fraction of the cost. The Maldives are for those prioritizing absolute privacy and luxury resort amenities, with budgets starting much higher.

categories.name: h2 id="costs-budget">💰 Costs & Budget
categories.summary: The Andaman Islands offer a complete island experience for a fraction of the cost of the Maldives.

categories.name: h2 id="beaches-scenery">🏖️ Beaches & Scenery
categories.summary: The Maldives offers an unmatched level of pristine, perfectly maintained beach aesthetics and clarity of water.

categories.name: h2 id="activities-adventure">🤿 Activities & Adventure
categories.summary: The Andaman Islands provide a more diverse range of activities, including historical sites and land-based exploration, complementing the water sports.

categories.name: h2 id="accommodation">🏨 Accommodation
categories.summary: The Andaman Islands offer a more accessible and diverse range of accommodation choices for various budgets.

categories.name: h2 id="food-dining">🍽️ Food & Dining
categories.summary: The Andaman Islands offer more authentic, flavorful, and significantly more affordable dining experiences, especially for fresh seafood.

categories.name: h2 id="getting-there-around">✈️ Getting There & Around
categories.summary: The Andaman Islands offer more independent and affordable options for internal travel and better value for initial flights.

categories.name: h2 id="culture-local-interaction">🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Culture & Local Interaction
categories.summary: The Andaman Islands offer extensive opportunities for genuine cultural immersion and interaction with diverse local communities.

categories.name: h2 id="safety-solitude">🧘 Safety & Solitude
categories.summary: The Maldives provides an unparalleled level of personal safety and absolute privacy, especially on its private resort islands.

categories.name: h2 id="family-travel">👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Travel
categories.summary: The Andaman Islands provide a more affordable, culturally enriching, and activity-diverse family vacation experience.

categories.name: h2 id="solo-travel-digital-nomad-suitability">💻 Solo Travel / Digital Nomad Suitability
categories.summary: The Andaman Islands provide a more accessible and socially engaging environment for solo travelers and offer improving infrastructure for remote work.

faq.question: What is the typical flight time from India to each destination?
faq.answer: A direct flight from major Indian cities like Chennai or Kolkata to Port Blair in the Andaman Islands takes approximately 2.5 to 3.5 hours. For the Maldives, a flight from a South Indian city like Bengaluru to Male takes around 4 hours, with connecting flights often taking longer.

faq.question: Which destination is better for scuba diving?
faq.answer: Both offer excellent diving. The Andaman Islands are better for budget-conscious divers, with single dives costing 4,000-7,000 INR (48-85 USD). The Maldives provides world-class diving with more consistent visibility and larger pelagic encounters but at a higher price, typically 80-150 USD per dive.

faq.question: Can I find vegetarian or vegan food easily?
faq.answer: In the Andaman Islands, finding vegetarian food is very easy due to Indias culinary traditions; vegan options require specifying. In the Maldives, resorts cater to all dietary needs at higher prices, while local islands have fewer dedicated vegan options but can adapt meals.

faq.question: What is the best time of year to visit each location?
faq.answer: The best time to visit the Andaman Islands is from October to May, when the weather is dry and pleasant. The Maldives also experiences its dry season from December to April, offering minimal rain and calm seas, which is ideal for water activities.

faq.question: Is alcohol readily available in both destinations?
faq.answer: In the Andaman Islands, alcohol is readily available at licensed shops, bars, and restaurants, similar to mainland India. In the Maldives, alcohol is generally only available on private resort islands; local islands are dry due to Islamic law.

faq.question: How much does a typical week-long trip cost for two people?
faq.answer: A week-long trip for two to the Andaman Islands can cost approximately 70,000-150,000 INR (850-1,800 USD) for mid-range travel. A similar trip to the Maldives for two, staying at a mid-range resort, would likely start from 3,500-7,000 USD, excluding international flights.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for either destination?
faq.answer: For the Andaman Islands (part of India), most foreign nationals require an Indian visa. For the Maldives, many nationalities receive a free 30-day tourist visa on arrival, but it is always best to check specific requirements for your nationality before travel.

faq.question: What is the internet and phone connectivity like?
faq.answer: In the Andaman Islands, connectivity is improving, with 4G available in main towns and islands like Havelock. It can be patchy in remote areas. In the Maldives, resorts offer excellent Wi-Fi, but local islands have slower and less reliable internet access. International roaming is expensive in both.
